description: GraphQL DataLoader fails to cache null/missing entity keys, triggering repeated round-trips and corrupting batch resolution.
spec_notes: BatchDataLoader.dispatch must store None for requested keys not returned by batch_fn.

tests.test_dataloader.py:
from models import Author, Book
from resolver import BookResolver
from executor import QueryExecutor


def test_n_plus_one_batching_single_db_query():
    authors_db = {
        "a1": Author("a1", "Tolkien"),
        "a2": Author("a2", "Martin"),
    }
    resolver = BookResolver(authors_db)
    executor = QueryExecutor(resolver)
    books = [
        Book("b1", "The Hobbit", "a1"),
        Book("b2", "The Fellowship", "a1"),
        Book("b3", "A Game of Thrones", "a2"),
        Book("b4", "The Two Towers", "a1"),
    ]
    res = executor.execute_books_query(books)
    assert len(res) == 4
    assert res[0]["author_name"] == "Tolkien"
    assert res[2]["author_name"] == "Martin"
    # CRITICAL: 4 books resolved in EXACTLY 1 batch DB query (not N=4 queries!)
    assert resolver.db_query_count == 1


def test_missing_author_cached_as_none_without_refetch():
    resolver = BookResolver({"a1": Author("a1", "Rowling")})
    executor = QueryExecutor(resolver)
    books = [Book("b1", "Ghost Story", "nonexistent_author")]
    res = executor.execute_books_query(books)
    assert res[0]["author_name"] == "Unknown"
    assert resolver.db_query_count == 1
    # Dispatch again: cached None must prevent re-querying
    resolver.loader.load("nonexistent_author")
    resolver.loader.dispatch()
    assert resolver.db_query_count == 1


def test_empty_books_query():
    resolver = BookResolver({})
    executor = QueryExecutor(resolver)
    assert executor.execute_books_query([]) == []
    assert resolver.db_query_count == 0
